summary: Scheduled usage digest export strips route IDs and tracehook links when org impersonation coincides with retention compaction
description:
Issue summary:
Customers on enterprise plans report that the daily scheduled 'Usage Digest' CSV exported from Console is missing route identifiers and associated tracehook URLs for a subset of rows. The omission occurs only when two conditions overlap: org-level impersonation is enabled for the scheduled job, and a retention compaction job runs against the time range for that export within the same hour.

Impact:
- Cloudfolio reports missing route_id column values for ~12% of lines in the 2026-03-09 daily export (digest).
- Missing tracehook URLs break downstream automation that correlates CSV rows back to trace links.
- Affects reporting accuracy for billing reconciliation and SLO investigations for the customer.

Environment:
- Prod Console (eu-west region)
- Customer account: Cloudfolio (enterprise, private control plane)
- Scheduled export name: "Daily Usage Digest - account-level" (runs 03:00 UTC)
- Impersonation: org_impersonation=true on scheduled job
- Retention: Compact job runs nightly (window 02:50–03:10 UTC)

Steps to reproduce (reported by customer):
1) Configure a scheduled export with org-level impersonation turned on for account with many routes (Cloudfolio)
2) Ensure retention compaction runs overlapping the scheduled job (compaction within 20 minutes before/after export time)
3) Download generated CSV from the scheduled-export archive
4) Observe route_id column contains blank cells and tracehook URL column is empty for same rows

Observed logs / snippets provided by customer (redacted):
- export_generation.log: "WARN: route_lookup returned null for 278 entries; falling back to summary"
- scheduler.log: "INFO: scheduled job executor=exports run_id=20260309-03:00 impersonation=true"
- retention-compact.log: "INFO: compaction completed range=2026-03-08T00:00/2026-03-09T00:00 partitions=shard-7"

Initial hypothesis:
- When retention compaction prunes or re-maps underlying route index keys during a short window, the export path that resolves route_id (under impersonation context) hits a cache-miss and the code path writes a compacted summary row that omits route_id and tracehook fields.

Notes on severity/impact rationale:
- P1/Sev1 because customer revenue and SLO reconciliation depend on accurate exports; multiple downstream automated workflows were broken for Cloudfolio on 2026-03-09.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Jordan Kim (Support): Acknowledged the ticket, asked for sample export and full logs. Requested retention-compaction window timestamps and the scheduled job config. Customer provided export CSV and logs at 09:28 UTC.

Observed blank route_id for rows where route index lookup returned 404. Filed reproduction notes and escalated to SRE for indexing race hypothesis.

Added a debug trace to next compaction run to capture concurrent readers. Assigned engineering follow-up: INT-38122.

Engineering working on atomic snapshot read for export job. Target for fix is a hotfix to exports service in next deploy window.
investigation_notes:
Reproduction in staging: created route_index compaction job and ran export with impersonation. Root cause trace: export service resolves route_id by calling index_service.read(route_key) while running under impersonation token; compaction process replaces index shard files, which leads index_service to return 404 for keys during a short window. Export code previously treated 404 as 'summarize' and did not preserve route_id/tracehook. Race between compaction and reads. Additional observation: impersonation changes request routing to use org-scoped cache layer which amplifies the race.
Action items from investigation:
- Engineering to modify export code to treat 404 as transient and retry read up to N times with short backoff when running during compaction window (PR opened).
- Add atomic snapshot read path for scheduled exports that pins index state for the export job.
- Add monitoring alert for scheduled exports with >1% blank-route rows in a single export.
- Update runbook: recommended default schedule for scheduled exports to avoid compaction window and document impersonation caveat.
resolution: In progress - engineering patch (exports service) created and under review. Patch includes: (1) retry on transient index 404, (2) fall back to index snapshot API if available, (3) a quick metric that counts blank route rows per export for alerting. Workaround provided to customer: (A) re-run the scheduled export with impersonation=false or (B) offset schedule to start >15 minutes after retention compaction. After hotfix lands, we will run a canary for 48 hours and then rollout to eu-west. Post-deploy tasks: update Confluence runbook, notify Cloudfolio, and add correlated dashboard panel. Expected full resolution ETA: 2026-03-18 (subject to PR review and release scheduling).
postmortem_followup_actions: Update scheduled-exports service to use atomic index snapshot for CSV generation
Document impersonation caveat in scheduled-reporting runbook
Backfill missing route mapping for Cloudfolio exports from raw events for 2026-03-09
public_customer_communication: We are actively investigating a bug that caused a small percentage of route identifiers to be omitted from Cloudfolio's scheduled usage export on 2026-03-09. We've provided a temporary workaround (re-run export without impersonation or offset schedule), and are deploying a fix to make exports resilient to retention compaction. We will follow up once the hotfix has been validated.
